what: The photo attached to each news list row hides in the bottom-right corner of the screen (440px square) and opens with clip in .45s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) from the side the pointer entered the row (top if the upper half, bottom if the lower half). Moving to another row leaves the previous photo in place and stacks a new one on top, opening it. Leaving the list closes it toward the exit side and hides it after 450ms. The photo box fades in and floats up, and hides, in .45s. The photo inside is kept scaled to 1.08 and shifts ±4.5px opposite the mouse position within the row (.18s ease-out)

options.rest: Time from start of closing until hidden (ms), default 450
options.range: Shift amount inside the photo (px), default 4.5 — 0 means no shift
options.zoom: Scale inside the photo (always applied — so edges never show when shifted), default 1.08. Also accepted via the CSS variable --fx-zoom
options.--fx-size·--fx-right·--fx-bottom: Photo size and corner position (CSS variables), default 440px · 0 · 0

note: Below 960px and on devices without hover the photo is hidden (the original is display none on phones too)
